description: This file defines the JsonPipeDispatcher class, which manages message passing through a JSON pipe in the Playwright core server. It handles sending messages, closing the pipe, dispatching incoming messages, and cleanup.

classes.name: JsonPipeDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class responsible for managing JSON pipe communication within the Playwright server. It handles message transmission, closure, and event dispatching.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message through the JSON pipe and emits a 'message' event.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the JSON pipe, emits a 'close' event, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an incoming message if the pipe is not disposed.

methods.name: wasClosed
methods.description: Handles the pipe closure, optionally with a reason, and emits a 'closed' event.

ctags.name: JsonPipeDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class JsonPipeDispatcher extends Dispatcher<SdkObject, channels.JsonPipeChannel, LocalUti/
